new_results.statement: For exact rank-three A=UMU^T, any invertible original-coordinate physical 2x2 block B=RMR^T may be integrated exactly. If the complement Gram G=I-R^TR is positive definite and every remaining whitened leverage u_j^T G^{-1}u_j is at most 1/2, then Q has a continuous density and ||p_Q||_infinity <= 12 [|det M| det G]^(-1/3). No lower bound on |det B| survives.
With g=det(RR^T), the rank-one Schur coefficient theta=det(M)g/det(B), the three-dimensional Fresnel change has Jacobian g^(-1/2), and |det B|^(-1/2)|theta|^(-1/2)sqrt(g)=|det M|^(-1/2).

For near-coloop hub Gram G_L=I-hrr^T and leaf leverage ell_i=u_i^T G_L^{-1}u_i, deleting hub and leaf gives det G_i=(1-h)(1-ell_i), with post-deletion leverage ell_(j|i)=ell_j+(u_j^T G_L^{-1}u_i)^2/(1-ell_i).

next_step: Spend the previously proved disjoint packet W_H T_JK>0.05379357 while retaining the hub-containing triple phase through the first Fresnel integration; do not replace the full transformed product by its absolute Wiener integral and do not peel the hub before spending T_JK.
continuity_scope: The new two-hub diffuse-complement theorem and the applied partner exact-coloop rank-one branch have continuous densities. No continuity claim is made for the unresolved punctured ultra-coloop branch.
